name: Cheval Blanc St Barth Isle de France

address.street: Cheval Blanc St Barth Isle de France

insider_take: This isn't just luxury—it's Caribbean perfection reimagined by LVMH's crown jewel hospitality brand on one of the world's most exclusive islands.
whats_special: Occupying the legendary site of the original Isle de France hotel, Cheval Blanc sits on Flamands Beach—consistently ranked among the Caribbean's finest white sand stretches. The property features stunning overwater suites and beachfront villas designed by Jacques Grange, plus the island's only Guerlain spa. As part of LVMH's ultra-luxury portfolio, it delivers Parisian sophistication meets tropical bliss.
pro_tip: Book the Flamands Suite for unobstructed sunset views and your own private slice of beach—it's where A-listers hideaway during peak season.
dont_miss: Sunset cocktails at La Case, the beachfront restaurant where Caribbean spiny lobster meets French culinary artistry. The hotel's location also puts you minutes from Shell Beach for snorkeling and the charming village of Corossol, where traditional straw hat weaving continues as it has for centuries.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Flamands Beach
Exceptional French luxury hospitality and service
Sophisticated cuisine with world-class dining experiences
Elegant accommodations with premium amenities and ocean views
cons: Remote Caribbean island location requires connecting flights
